# Kelick Tech Hub

> Kelick Tech Hub is a tech learning hub by Obi Emeka: learn C++ by building projects, read fact-checked daily tech news, explore verified GitHub repository guides, and master Linux.

## Sections

- [Kelick Tech Hub](https://malwar77.github.io/): The full hub on one page — C++ project catalogue, tech news blog, GitHub repo guides, Linux and security library, and an experimental sandbox.
- [C++ Projects](https://malwar77.github.io/projects.html): 60 C++ project ideas across beginner, intermediate and advanced levels, each with a full build lecture, starter code, and compile/run instructions. Full list in llms-full.txt.
- [Tech News Blog](https://malwar77.github.io/news.html): Daily "Tech Today" roundups — technology news verified against primary sources — plus longer fact-checked articles.
- [GitHub Repo Guides](https://malwar77.github.io/repo-guides.html): Verified open-source repository guides with honest requirements, catches, and setup instructions.
- [Linux & Security](https://malwar77.github.io/linux.html): Linux news and a library of distro guides with VirtualBox and USB install routes.
- [Experimental Sandbox](https://malwar77.github.io/): Browser-only simulated terminals (Termux, Windows cmd, Linux bash) for practice.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://malwar77.github.io/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable sitemap for the site.
